test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A laptop charger is sold for Rs. 2,540 in cash or for a down payment of Rs. 1,340 in cash together with Rs. 1,205 to be paid after one month. Find the rate of interest charged in the instalment scheme.
solution:
**Given:**

Cash price of the laptop charger = Rs. 2,540

Down payment = Rs. 1,340

Amount to be paid after one month = Rs. 1,205

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest formula: SI = (P × R × T) / 100

Where:

 
• P = Principal amount (Rs. 1,200)
 
• R = Rate of interest per annum
 
• T = Time (1 month = 1/12 year)

**Calculation:**

Correct Principal amount P = 2,540 - 1,340 = 1,200

Interest amount I = 1,205 - 1,200 = 5

Using the Simple Interest formula:

5 = (1,200 × R × 1/12) / 100

⇒ 5 = (1,200 × R) / 1,200

⇒ R = 5%

**The rate of interest charged in the instalment scheme is 5% p.a.**
